common:synonyms.#text: Welded Pipe; Welded Tubings
焊接管；焊接管道

common:generalComment.#text: Welding steel pipe is a method for joining two pipes together using techniques such as MIG welding and TIG welding. Welded pipe is a tubular product made out of flat plates, known as skelp, that are formed, bent, and prepared for welding. The most popular process for large diameter pipe uses a longitudinal seam weld. Welding steel pipes is a multi-million dollar industry, growing every day to cater to the endless demand for the welded tubings. The pipe can be rotated around the x-axis or y-axis while the welder remains stationary.
焊接钢管是一种使用MIG焊接和TIG焊接等技术将两根管子连接在一起的方法。焊接管是由平板制成的管状产品，这些平板被称为剥离板，它们被成型、弯曲并准备好进行焊接。大直径管最常用的工艺是纵向接缝焊。焊接钢管是一个价值数百万美元的行业，每天都在增长，以满足对焊接管材的无尽需求。在焊工保持静止的情况下，可以围绕x轴或y轴旋转管道。

common:synonyms.#text: 切削液；金属加工液；切削冷却润滑液
cutting fluid; metalworking fluid; cutting coolant and lubricant

common:generalComment.#text: Cutting fluid is a type of coolant and lubricant designed specifically for metalworking processes, such as machining and stamping. It includes oils, oil-water emulsions, pastes, gels, aerosols, and air or other gases. It is used in the metalworking process like cutting, drilling, milling, turning to reduce the heat produced due to the deformation and machining process to lubricate for reducing friction and wear and tear on the workpiece. These fluids are typically produced by a simple process of mixing water and mineral oils, fatty oils, and vegetable oils, with an emulsifier.
切削液是一种专为金属加工过程（如机械加工和冲压）设计的冷却剂和润滑剂。它包括油、油水乳化液、膏、凝胶、气雾剂以及空气或其他气体。在金属加工过程中，如切削、钻孔、铣削、车削等，使用切削液可以减少由于变形和机械加工过程产生的热量，润滑以减少摩擦和工件的磨损。这些液体通常通过简单的混合水和矿物油、脂肪油、植物油以及乳化剂的过程来生产。

common:generalComment.#text: Printed matter is a term used to describe mechanically printed materials, mostly used by mailing systems, for which reduced fees are paid. Each postal administration has its own rules for what may be posted as printed matter. Paper 3D printing allows companies to quickly, cleanly, cheaply and repeatedly craft product prototypes to visualize a final design in physical form.
印刷品是一个用来描述机械印刷材料的术语，主要由邮寄系统使用，为此支付较低的费用。每个邮政管理部门都有自己的规定，规定什么可以作为印刷品邮寄。纸质3D打印让公司能够快速、干净、便宜且反复地制作产品原型，以便在物理形式上可视化最终设计。

黄铜床；黄铜桌；铁制面包架；金属陈列柜

common:generalComment.#text: Metal furniture is a popular choice of furnishings, often used outdoors for decks and patios. It can also be used indoors, such as brass beds, brass tables, iron bakers racks and metal curio cabinets. It is generally more durable than wooden furniture and can withstand more wear and tear. It is well-sealed, so it can withstand drink rings, punctures, and general heavy use. This makes it perfect for environments like dorm rooms or hospitals.
金属家具是一种受欢迎的家居选择，常用于户外的甲板和露台。它也可以用于室内，如黄铜床、黄铜桌、铁制烘焙架和金属摆设柜。它通常比木质家具更耐用，可以承受更多的磨损。它经过良好的密封，所以可以承受饮料环、穿孔和一般的重度使用。这使得它非常适合像宿舍房间或医院这样的环境。
